$comment: Community skills vendored into the composition, each pinned to one commit. This file is the whole record: what we took, from where, at which commit, under which licence, and why. `pnpm vendor:community-skills` reads it, fetches exactly these commits, runs the intake checks and rewrites the directories. Nothing here updates on its own — the ecosystem moves weekly and a skill that changes under us changes what the model is told to do.

skills.name: dsh-ppt
skills.why: One sentence or a document to an HTML deck plus an editable PPTX. Self-contained: the deck builder ships inside the skill directory and runs under the bash tool, so nothing outside the sandbox is needed. Covers the teaching-deck and report-readout requests that manuscript-support has no answer for. Re-pinned 2026-10-13 from 0db836e8 to 9ab3c88e (0.2.1, upstream issue #1): the older build wrote every local-header offset in the zip's central directory as 0, so the PPTX it produced could not be opened by python-pptx, Info-ZIP or any reader that follows the central directory (a real run's deck failed `unzip -t` with an overlapped-components error). The fix-only commit is taken rather than the current 0.9.0, whose later references name plugin-only tools and an npm install the sandbox cannot run.

skills.name: deep-structural-analysis
skills.why: Sixteen adversarial lenses with calibrated confidence, as an extra review perspective beside our own rubric. Taken despite naming web search as a phase, because it declares a search-unavailable fallback that labels every framework-anchored conclusion as theoretical inference at low confidence and prints a visible notice — which is what our own runtime, having no direct egress, needs it to do.

deferred.name: writing-guard
deferred.reason: Bundle-form, not skill-form: its SKILL.md calls `writing_audit()` twelve times, and that tool comes from the plugin half of the package. Vendoring the prose alone would instruct the model to call a tool that does not exist. Belongs in the try-install lane, where the bundle is pinned into the image whole. Tried 2026-10-13: its postinstall copies a skill and a Python module into $DSH_HOME, which the sealed profile's build policy refuses (plugin-support.json).

deferred.name: dsh-cite
deferred.reason: Tool bundle, not a vendored skill. Installed whole at 0.3.2; public buildCiteTools registers cite_lookup, cite_format, cite_bibtex, cite_check and cite_health through the managed public-source gateway. Runtime readiness is checked separately from installation.

deferred.name: academic-writing
deferred.reason: Registers the `academic_writing` tool. Try-install lane. Tried 2026-10-13 at 0.3.2: boots on the pinned kernel; not taken (plugin-support.json).

deferred.name: translation
deferred.reason: Registers a translation tool. Try-install lane. Tried 2026-10-13 at 0.3.2: boots on the pinned kernel; not taken (plugin-support.json).
